summary_en: Medipal Holdings (parent) completed tender offer for PALTAC ordinary shares 12 May–7 Jul 2026. 28,940,739 shares acquired. Minimum threshold 8,676,100 shares. Offer price not disclosed in excerpt.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Shares of PALTAC Corporation by Parent Company Medipal Holdings Corporation
translation_en_brief: On 8 July 2026, Medipal Holdings Corporation (the parent company and offeror) announced completion of its tender offer for ordinary shares of PALTAC Corporation (TSE Prime Market, code 8283). The offer ran from 12 May to 7 July 2026. A total of 28,940,739 shares were acquired, with a minimum threshold of 8,676,100 shares. The filing notes that US depositary receipts for PALTAC shares were excluded from the offer pursuant to regulatory approval from the Kanto Financial Bureau. Specific offer price and final payout value are not disclosed in the excerpt provided.
